items.subject: When a family at Crossroads Christian Center needs help

args.subject: When a family at Crossroads Christian Center needs help
args.body:
Hello Crossroads Christian Center team,

I'm Harshit, the founder of CouponDonation.

When a family at Crossroads Christian Center is in need of food, groceries, travel or health benefits, the people around them usually want to help and don't know how. We give them a way.

The family, or someone at the church for them, starts a free page. People give from $10. Each gift reaches the family as a store gift card, never cash, and the giver is told when it's received and used.

We take no fee from the gift. 100% goes to the families.

If a family comes to mind, or asks you for help, this is the page to pass on:
https://www.coupondonation.com/apply

Questions? Just reply. Or, if you'd like to know more about us, book a 30-minute call with us here:
https://calendly.com/connect-coupondonation/-

Harshit Agrawal
Founder, CouponDonation

--
CouponDonation Inc., 300 Creek View Road, Suite 209, Newark, DE 19711
You're receiving this because Crossroads Christian Center's email is on its public listing.
Reply "no thanks" or "unsubscribe" and I won't write again. You can also write to unsubscribe@outreach.coupondonation.com.
